verdict.rationale: Docs vaguely gesture at automation depth ("automate repetitive tasks", Cowork's "bigger, multi-step tasks") and connectors for finding/acting on files, but there is no concrete evidence of Copilot performing bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch-editing many files, mass email actions, applying an operation to a whole dataset) — most citations are single-item lookups ("find my spreadsheet", "show me this email"). Community reports even describe failures on basic single-document tasks in Word, further undercutting confidence in larger-scale batch automation. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation examples, independent hands-on confirmation of multi-item automation, and detail on scale/limits of Cowork's multi-step tasks.
